def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); components=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==2 and p not in seen:
                        seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
            components.append(cells)
    out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    # Each component is a T tetromino; stamp its orientation at the location
    # of its 3x3 cell in the coarse 3-by-6 layout.
    for cells in components:
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
        shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells}
        rmid=min(2, (r0*3)//h)

        elif shape=={(0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0)}: color=3
        elif shape=={(0,2),(1,1),(1,2),(2,2)}: color=1
        else: continue
        out[rmid][cmid]=color
    return out
